title: US Divorce Fell To 2.4 Per Thousand
hook: US divorce fell to 2.4 people per thousand.
closing: Later marriage and lower divorce mean the old scary statistic no longer fits today's couples.
question: Did you think divorce was rising?

segments.say: Over three decades, divorce nearly halved to 2.4 people per thousand each year, and it is still falling.
Women first marry at 28.6, almost five years later than before, while fewer marriages end.
